binary_contract.element_order: C (row-major), dimensions as listed per blob
binary_contract.compression: gzip, mtime zeroed so identical content hashes identically
binary_contract.absent_cell_semantics: zero means no flow, not missing
binary_contract.nan_semantics: NaN appears only in tool/need_* and means the need mass is unavailable for that recipient. Treat it as unknown, never as zero, and block any objective weighting that would consume it.
binary_contract.consumer_rule: Verify every axis hash before indexing. On any mismatch, refuse to render rather than guess.

year_convention: axes.year contains projection years 2025-2028 only. Observed 2024 is served by static/baseline_* and cube/baseline__* on the separate cube/support2024__* support. static/total_oda_* uses axes.total_oda_year.

cube.purpose: The full donor x recipient x sector x year allocation, for charts the five aggregate grains cannot serve.
cube.encoding: sparse: one shared support index, one value array per scenario and measure
cube.donor_slicing: cube/support__donor_offsets gives exact CSR boundaries: donor i occupies cells [offsets[i], offsets[i+1]).
cube.absent_cell_semantics: A key outside the support, or a zero within it, means no allocation. The support is the union across all ten scenarios, so a cell one scenario does not populate is present and reads zero.
cube.loading: Not part of the eager payload. Fetch cube/<scenario>__<measure> on demand; one scenario in both measures is about 519 KB gzipped.
cube.consumer_rule: Verify support_sha256 against the concatenated support index arrays, in the order donor, recipient, sector, year, before using any value array. On mismatch refuse to render: a value array is meaningless without the index it was built against.

cube2024.purpose: Observed 2024 donor x recipient x sector allocation baseline.
cube2024.consumer_rule: Verify support_sha256 against cube/support2024__donor_index, recipient_index and sector_index before reading cube/baseline__*.

XKV.reason: Kosovo has no feature in the selected world-atlas geometry.

recipient_geometry_key.decision: Kosovo remains in all model totals and non-map charts but is not shaded on the choropleth until the map bundle supplies a stable Kosovo feature.

recipient_meta_note: Denominators for the exposure ratios. Null means unavailable, and the interface must show the ratio as unavailable rather than substituting a value. Yemen and South Sudan have no source GNI and remain null rather than receiving a GDP proxy. Population is supplied where available.
total_oda_aggregation_rule: Per-provider values include EU Institutions. Sovereign headline totals sum only donor_meta entries with include_in_sovereign_effort_total=true; adding EU Institutions would double count member-state contributions.
total_oda_gross_status: Not emitted for 2025-2028. donor_envelopes.csv is a grant-equivalent series, while the documented pooled 2022-2024 GE-to-gross conversion applies to recipient-sector cells and cannot validly convert regional, core-multilateral or other total-ODA components. Scenario and baseline matrix gross blobs use the documented cell/instrument conversion.
coverage_note: Share of each donor's ODA the recipient-level figures cover. A low of_total_oda can mean the donor gives multilaterally, which is a policy choice, not a reporting failure.

static/total_oda_ge__donor_year.note: Per-provider values. Do not sum EU Institutions with sovereign donors: member-state contributions would be double counted.

static/specification_split__donor.units: US$ million, gross CRS disbursements, constant 2024 prices
static/specification_split__donor.note: Categories are recipient+sector specified, recipient specified/sector missing, region-only, wholly unspecified.

static/reallocation_vs_s1__scenario_dono.units: percent of the S1 grant-equivalent donor-year matrix envelope
static/reallocation_vs_s1__scenario_dono.note: 0.5 * sum over recipient-sector cells of |scenario - S1|, divided by the S1 envelope.
